Low-probability race: pending is keyed only by threshold, with no generation token. If a window resets (drops below the minimum) and crosses the same threshold again while the first add() is still in flight, the old completion acts on the new pending entry. A late success drops the new crossing's rollback; a late failure un-marks a new crossing that may still be delivered, which can cause one duplicate. For this to happen the reset and re-cross must both land within the add() latency (milliseconds), against a 300 s tick.
